id_status: PROPOSED: next unassigned number after SG-000130; final id is part of founder decision FD-UP-4
title: Unified platform contracts v1, audit hash chain with external anchor, and licence gates (inert)

dependency_notes.SG-000093: Closed. Its AuthorityMode, ExecutorClass and ExecutionState vocabularies move to orcel-contracts with identical serde spellings and are re-exported from orcel-policy; lease issuance, lease ids and binding digests stay in orcel-policy with their existing encodings.

objective: Give every later unified-platform grain one set of versioned wire contracts in crates/orcel-contracts (principal and device, per-OS identity binding, lease view and grant reference bound to orcel_session_id, session, tool registry entry with a lease gate that never replaces an approval, capability discovery with explicit unsupported, the job state machine reusing not_started|dispatched|completed|cancelled|outcome_unknown, the audit event, the sidecar IPC handshake, heartbeat and kill, WebCrawlRequest, and additive failure codes with a complete HTTP mapping), a SHA-256 hash chain in orcel-audit written before every dispatch and anchored outside executor reach (Windows Event Log and the Full Control indicator), an `orcel audit verify` command, and CI gates for per-crate and per-package licences, AGPL markers and the kernel dependency direction. Nothing becomes reachable by any client.

include: WP1-00: activation of this grain and of the other Wave 1 drafts the founder approves; Firecrawl status correction in DONOR_REGISTRY.md and donor_registry.json.

WP1-01: root deny.toml (licences, bans, sources); scripts/check-npm-licenses.mjs over every package-lock.json under apps/, packages/ and tests/; scripts/check-agpl-markers.mjs over crates/, apps/, packages/ and tests/, accepting AGPL markers only in docs/orcel/notices/fd06-files.txt paths; a cargo metadata test enforcing section 3.2 of the spec.

WP1-02: section 4 contract types with golden JSON fixtures; schemars =1.2.3 as a dev-dependency only, with a schema drift test; canonical_json for new contract digests, with SG-000093, SG-000018, SG-000019 and SG-000040 digests exempt and unchanged; FailureCode variants LEASE_REQUIRED, LEASE_INVALID, LEASE_UNSUPPORTED_PLATFORM, INDICATOR_UNAVAILABLE, UNSUPPORTED, POLICY_BLOCKED, JOB_NOT_FOUND, QUEUE_FULL, RATE_LIMITED and OUTCOME_UNKNOWN; FailureCode::http_status covering every variant including PATH_ESCAPE (403) and PATH_RACE_DETECTED (409).

WP1-03: hash-chained audit events; lease events carry AuthorityAuditEvent verbatim (AuditKind unchanged); dispatch events written and flushed before the executor starts, with dispatch refused on write failure; argv, URLs and query strings recorded as SHA-256 digests; anchor events every 32 events and on lease, emergency_stop and shutdown, recorded in the Windows Application log per user through an unregistered RegisterEventSourceW('Orcel') handle (event id 4100; no source registration, which would need administrator rights); `orcel audit verify` checking every Orcel anchor record still in the log, with a conflicting record a break and a beyond-tail record a truncation; if the anchor cannot be written, Full Control is refused (no indicator-only fallback); rotation continuity.
exclude: Any new MCP tool, REST route, executor, runtime dependency in crates/*, listener, network path or authority.
Any change to lease issuance, lease ids, binding digests, existing approval digests or Safe-mode policy.
macOS and Linux identity readers and log anchors (Wave 2).

authority_delta.contracts: None. Wire types only; no issuance, no checking, no secret material.
authority_delta.audit: None in what is permitted. Adds integrity evidence and a refusal when evidence cannot be written; redaction is tightened (digests for argv and URLs), never loosened.

decisions.question: Activate this grain and its id

invariants: orcel-contracts depends only on serde and serde_json at runtime and contains no platform-specific code.
Every existing wire spelling, including FailureCode values and the orcel-full-control-lease/1 schema, is unchanged.
SG-000093 lease ids and binding digests and existing approval digests keep their encodings.
Inbound authority-bearing contract objects refuse unknown fields.
LeaseView is a projection and is never accepted as proof of authority.
No dispatch runs without its audit event durably written first.
No durable anchor means no Full Control; the indicator display is never the anchor.
Audit events never contain a raw SID, token handle, credential, secret, raw argv, raw URL or page content.
No kernel crate depends on an app, test, package or third_party unit.
No new AGPL-marked file exists outside the FD-06 allowlist.
acceptance: Every new contract type round-trips its golden fixture; unknown fields are refused where required; schema drift fails CI.
Every FailureCode variant has an HTTP mapping (enumeration test).
orcel-policy's existing tests pass unchanged after the vocabulary move.

Editing, deleting or reordering one audit line is reported at that line; tail truncation is reported against the newest Event Log anchor; a forged conflicting anchor record is a break; rotation keeps continuity.
A simulated audit write failure refuses the dispatch; a simulated anchor write failure refuses Full Control.
The anchor write and read-back succeed, and clearing the log is refused, when run as a standard (non-administrator) account on the Windows runner and on the founder's PC.
Root cargo deny, the npm licence check and the AGPL marker scan pass on current main; fixtures with an AGPL dependency or an AGPL header outside the allowlist fail them.
The dependency-direction test fails for a fixture edge from a kernel crate to an app.
tests: cargo test -p orceld --test audit_anchor_standard_user (Windows, run under a temporary standard account)
cargo deny check licenses bans sources
